steps.title: Base layer (6x6)
steps.description: Place 3x DBG 2x6 plates side-by-side to form a 6x6 footprint.

steps.title: Reinforce base
steps.description: Stack 3x DBG 2x6 plates on top, rotated 90° to lock seams.

steps.title: Tile front + sides
steps.description: Add 2 side 1x4 tiles; front gets 1x 2x2 tile + 2x 1x2 grille tiles.

steps.title: Finish back + foot studs
steps.description: Tile back with 1x 1x4 tile + 1x 1x2 grille; add 2 jumper plates for feet.

steps.title: Rear markers
steps.description: Add 2x DBG round 1x1 plates behind the jumpers as subtle base detail.
